heading: INT. HIGH SCHOOL GYM - AFTER PROM - 1 A.M.

units.text: INT. HIGH SCHOOL GYM - AFTER PROM - 1 A.M.
Crepe streamers drooping from the rafters.
Folding tables stacked on a wheeled cart.
A mop bucket in the center of the court, and a single overhead bank of lights left on.
THANH NGUYEN (17, in a rented tuxedo, bow tie undone and hanging, corsage still pinned to his lapel) sits on the bottom bleacher with his shoes in his lap.
CORDELIA PIERCE (17, in a lavender dress, hair collapsing, a plastic crown on her head) sweeps confetti into a pile with a push broom, though no one has asked her to.
She sweeps a long arc across the court, circles the free-throw line, and lets the pile grow at the base of the basket.

He peels the corsage from his lapel, studies it, sets it on the bench beside him, and then picks it up again, and then reaches over and sets it carefully on top of her heap of confetti, where it looks like a small, absurd flag.
You didn't have to stay and clean.
units.name: THANH

units.text: I was on the committee.
units.name: CORDELIA

units.text: So was everyone.
units.name: THANH

units.text: Everyone left.
units.name: CORDELIA

units.text: I guess that's what committees are for.
units.name: THANH

units.text: She leans the broom against the wall.
She takes off the crown and turns it over in her hands, then tosses it to him underhand.
He catches it, surprised, and puts it on.
It suits you.
units.name: CORDELIA

units.text: I look like an idiot.
units.name: THANH

units.text: A very handsome idiot.
units.name: CORDELIA

units.text: They sit.
The lights hum.
Far away, a car door slams in the lot, and an engine starts, and fades.
